verdict: FUNCTIONAL FORM UNRESOLVED. The algebra stands: fitting mu + a_i + a_j to a multiplicative surface leaves residual (rho_i - m)(rho_j - m), a U-shape with no blocs in the generating process, and that is what r27 measured. So the ADDITIVE decomposition four rounds relied on is demonstrably misspecifiable. But the multiplicative alternative is NOT thereby established. It wins only in sample, at equal effective degrees of freedom, and out of sample it is unstable: over ten held-out splits its R^2 ranges [-1.6442, +0.5109] against the additive shape's tight [+0.3377, +0.4208]. Raters with one or two training edges receive a c_i pinned to the 0.1 initialisation fallback -- a silent imputation -- and a single such split drags the mean below the additive model. Neither shape is validated, so the pair-specific residual question this round was built to settle is OPEN, and the both_low number below must not be read as a measurement of anything.
note: r23/r25/r26/r27 all fit A_ij = mu + a_i + a_j and read the residual as pair structure. Under one latent target with heterogeneous reliability, agreement is rho_i*rho_j, and an additive fit to that leaves residual (rho_i-m)(rho_j-m): positive at BOTH extremes, negative in the middle. That U-shape is exactly what r27 measured and read as a minority bloc.
